title: Python Developer
description: A comprehensive roadmap for becoming a professional Python developer, covering core language, advanced concepts, web APIs, databases, testing, automation, cloud deployment, and robust project delivery.

tree.name: Python Fundamentals & Development Environment
tree.description: Master the core Python language, foundational programming concepts, and establish a professional development environment with essential tools and best practices.

resources.title: Automate the Boring Stuff with Python
PEP 8 – Style Guide for Python Code

children.name: Python Core Language & Paradigms
children.description: Deep dive into Python's syntax, data types, control flow, functions, modules, classes, error handling, file I/O, and advanced language features like iterators, generators, decorators, context managers, type hinting, and asynchronous programming.

children.name: Development Environment & Tooling
children.description: Set up a robust development workflow using virtual environments (venv, conda), package managers (pip, Poetry/pip-tools), code formatters (Black), linters (Flake8), static type checkers (Mypy), and version control systems (Git & GitHub/GitLab). Understand project structuring, dependency management, and build tools.

resources.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Python! - Development Environments

children.name: Data Structures & Algorithms (Basics)
children.description: Understand fundamental data structures like lists, dictionaries, sets, tuples, and basic algorithms for sorting and searching, including common usage patterns. Grasp the concept of time and space complexity (Big O notation).

tree.name: Backend Web Development with Python
tree.description: Develop robust backend services and APIs using Python web frameworks, interact with various databases, and implement essential security practices for web applications.

children.name: Web Frameworks & API Design (FastAPI / Django)
children.description: Learn to build high-performance APIs and web applications. Master routing, request/response validation, middleware, request lifecycle, ORM integration, authentication, authorization, background tasks, serialization/deserialization, and API documentation using a framework like FastAPI (for async performance) or Django (for full-stack capabilities).

resources.title: Building a RESTful API with Django REST Framework

children.name: Database Management & ORMs
children.description: Gain proficiency in relational databases like PostgreSQL, SQL fundamentals, database design (normalization), and Object-Relational Mappers (ORMs) such as SQLAlchemy and Django ORM. Explore database migrations, indexing, transactions, connection pooling, query optimization, and an overview of NoSQL databases and caching strategies.

children.name: API Security & Best Practices
children.description: Implement crucial security measures for web APIs, including authentication (JWT, OAuth), authorization (RBAC), input validation, rate limiting, Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS), secure coding practices (e.g., preventing SQL injection, XSS), secret management, and HTTPS/SSL best practices.

tree.name: Automation, Testing & DevOps Fundamentals
tree.description: Build high-quality, reliable Python applications through comprehensive testing, automation of development workflows, and foundational DevOps practices including CI/CD and observability.

children.name: Automated Testing & Quality Assurance
children.description: Implement robust testing strategies including unit, integration, end-to-end, and regression tests using frameworks like pytest. Learn about fixtures, mocking, test coverage analysis, and the principles of Test-Driven Development (TDD).

children.name: Continuous Integration & Deployment (CI/CD)
children.description: Understand the principles of Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment. Set up automated build, test, and deployment pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins. Learn about artefact management, release management basics, and rollback strategies.

children.name: Scripting, Task Management & Automation
children.description: Develop powerful command-line interface (CLI) tools, automate routine tasks, perform system automation (e.g., file operations, process management), data extraction (APIs, web scraping, parsing), and manage background jobs using message queues (e.g., Celery, Redis Queue) and schedulers. Understand data serialization formats like JSON, YAML, and CSV.

children.name: Observability: Logging, Monitoring & Tracing
children.description: Implement robust logging strategies including structured logging, monitor application performance with metrics and dashboards, and understand distributed tracing to diagnose issues in complex systems. Learn to use tools like Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and establish effective alerting systems for proactive issue detection and root cause analysis.

tree.name: Deployment, Cloud & Advanced Project
tree.description: Prepare Python applications for production environments by containerizing, deploying to cloud platforms, and understanding advanced system design principles. Conclude with a comprehensive, industry-standard project.

children.name: Containerization with Docker
children.description: Master Docker fundamentals: writing efficient Dockerfiles (including multi-stage builds), building images, running containers, managing networks and volumes. Understand container best practices, security considerations, and use Docker Compose for orchestrating multi-service local development environments and deploying to image registries like Docker Hub.

children.name: Cloud Deployment & Infrastructure
children.description: Understand basic cloud computing concepts (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and deploy Python applications to public cloud providers (e.g., AWS EC2/Lambda/S3/RDS, Heroku, Render). Explore serverless functions, managed databases, cloud storage, basic networking (VPCs, Security Groups), and an introduction to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation).

children.name: System Design & Scalability Basics
children.description: Learn fundamental system design concepts for building scalable, resilient, and highly available applications. Cover topics like load balancing, API gateways, microservices vs. monoliths, message brokers (Kafka/RabbitMQ basics), event-driven architectures, caching strategies (CDN, in-memory, distributed), data consistency models, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery basics.

children.name: Final Project: Production-Ready Backend Service
children.description: Apply all learned skills by building a complete production-ready FastAPI or Django service. This project should include robust API design, database integration, comprehensive authentication and authorization, background tasks, extensive automated testing with CI/CD, Dockerization, monitoring and logging, deployment to a cloud environment, and clear API documentation (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI) with a focus on performance tuning.
